classifiedFinding.title: stakedId is owner-mutable (while totalStaked == 0); user stake transactions can race with setStakedId and lock units of an unintended NFT id

classification.assetImpact: Worst case: user stakes the wrong NFT id. Recoverable via unstake. No principal loss.
attackPath: 1. Owner is preparing a setStakedId migration (e.g., from BalancerPooler v1 NFT to v2).
2. User broadcasts a stake transaction expecting stakedId = oldId.
4. User's stake transfers units of newId from their wallet (because setApprovalForAll covers all ids) — they intended to stake oldId.
classification.likelihood: low - requires a setStakedId rotation overlapping a user stake; recoverable by unstake.
classification.assumptions: User has setApprovalForAll on stakedToken (common) and holds units of newId (less common).

classifiedFinding.justification: Low. Race-condition / UX issue. Recoverable via unstake. Recommendation: add an `expectedStakedId` parameter to stake() that reverts on mismatch, or document the race condition with off-chain coordination requirements during migrations.
